summary: Iteration 9 — Fase 2 (Produção Visual: cenas/overlays) + Agenda de Lives + Badge Ao Vivo. Added 5 new backend test classes (TestScenesAndActiveScene, TestBroadcastScheduleAndRemind, TestCronBroadcastReminders, TestLiveBroadcastsBadge, TestBroadcastPhase2StageInvariant) — 5/5 pass. Full suite: 92 passed / 1 skipped by design / 2 pre-existing flakes (notifications 100-cap, chat race — both documented in iteration 7/8, NOT caused by this phase). Frontend (mobile 390x844) validated: (a) MEMBRO Dashboard shows dash-live-badge '🔴 AO VIVO AGORA Adoração ao Vivo' and clicking navigates to /app/ao-vivo/{id}; (b) Viewer renders overlay-lower-third ('Maria Formadora Apresentadora') and overlay-banner ('🔴 Adoração ao Santíssimo') fed by heartbeat.active_scene; (c) BroadcastCenter shows 2 scheduled cards each with countdown (data-testid=countdown, tabular format começa em HH:MM:SS) and remind-{id} button — clicking toggles 'Lembrar-me' → 'Lembrete ativo' → back, with success toast; (d) FORMADOR /app/estudio/{live_id}: after grant_permissions(camera+microphone) + click request-devices-btn, camera stream starts and production-panel becomes visible with all 4 layout-{full,pip,side,content}, lower-third-name/role/toggle, banner-text/toggle, scene-add, screen-share-btn (all data-testid present). Applied layout-pip, lower-third-toggle and banner-toggle → each POST /active-scene returned 200 (no console errors, overlays rendered live). mode-toggle switched Simples → Profissional correctly; (e) PREVOC (etapa 1) sees only broadcasts with stages=[] (open to all) on /app/transmissoes and can view the open live — correct per broadcast_accessible() (empty stages == all). Backend curl verified: WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET pulled from backend/.env; POST /cron/broadcast-reminders → 401 without/with wrong Bearer, 200 with Bearer <secret>; scheduled broadcast within 15-min window triggers '📺 Sua live começa em breve' via BackgroundTasks (~1-8s delay); second cron call does NOT duplicate (notified=true guard). STAGE INVARIANT verified: after PUT /scenes, POST /active-scene, POST /remind, GET /live-broadcasts and POST /cron/broadcast-reminders the membro user.current_stage_order is unchanged. All test broadcasts deleted; formador restarted the seeded 'Adoração ao Vivo' broadcast (status=live, overlays on) so main agent can continue UI testing.

minor.issue: Still capped at .to_list(100) with no pagination/since filter — carried over from iterations 6/7/8. TestLivesLifecycle.test_start_and_end_live flakes when membro accumulated notification count reaches the cap (assert len(after) > len(before) becomes 100 > 100). NOT a Fase-2 regression; broadcast reminder detection in TestCronBroadcastReminders uses id-set diff instead of len() and passes reliably.

integration_issues.issue: Studio.addScene calls window.prompt() to get scene name; in Playwright headless the prompt is auto-dismissed (returns null) and no scene is created. Real users are unaffected. Consider replacing with an inline input for testability. Not blocking.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Replace window.prompt in Studio.addScene with an inline input/modal so the flow is exercisable in Playwright / mobile PWAs where prompt UX is poor.
(Nice-to-have, carried) Paginate /api/notifications so downstream tests/UI can reliably detect newly-created notifications when total > 100.
(Refactor, carried) server.py now ~2123 lines; broadcast+chat blocks (~500 lines) still strong candidates to split into backend/routers/.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /cron/broadcast-reminders uses BackgroundTasks correctly (returns 200 immediately) and secrets.compare_digest — good. However the guard `if not secret or not token` short-circuits — if WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET is empty in .env the endpoint permanently returns 401. Consider startup-time validation.

_process_broadcast_reminders iterates broadcasts × reminders sequentially with individual `await notify(...)` and `update_one` per reminder — N+1 pattern. For scale, batch by broadcast_id and use bulk update; currently fine.

POST /broadcasts/{bid}/active-scene has NO permission guard beyond can_operate_broadcast (owner/presenter/mestre/EDIT_ALL_CONTENT). PUT /broadcasts/{bid}/scenes requires MANAGE_SCENES. Contract is asymmetric — a presenter without MANAGE_SCENES can still change overlays via active-scene. Confirm intended.
GET /live-broadcasts uses .to_list(50) which is fine now but silently caps if 50+ concurrent lives ever exist.

GET /broadcasts recomputes reminded via `distinct(...)` per request (single roundtrip, OK) but broadcast_public() lacks a schema — new fields like scenes/active_scene are echoed as raw dicts with no validation.
